People: John Evelyn (author, Wikidata Q342712), died 1706; Richard Garnett (notes, Wikidata Q718512), died 1906; William Bray (editor, Wikidata Q8005877), died 1832. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Evelyn, John, 1620-1706; Garnett, Richard, 1835-1906 [Commentator]; Bray, William, 1736-1832 [Editor]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: The Diary Of John Evelyn Volume One, J. M. Dunt & Sons Ltd., 1936, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/diaryofjohnevely011613mbp. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 92%, 87%, 77% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Richard Garnett, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
